title: PH60308: General Theory Of Relativity
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Mathematical background\manifolds , tensor fields , connection and curvature ;
priniciple of equivalence and general covariance, geodesics and geodesic
deviation, action principle , Einstein s equation , solutions- black holes
(Schwarzschild, Reissner Nordstrom , Kerr) , Penrose diagrams , gravitational
waves and cosmology (FRW models and some observational cosmology) , initial
value problem , causal structure and singularities , black hole thermodynamics
, brief introduction to problems of quantising gravity.
